title: Recover bridge instance registry lifecycle

scope.claim: Recovers and implements the original bridge-store instance registration, handshake claim, reconnect generation routing, ordinary disconnect and explicit unregister semantics as a protocol-independent in-memory model. It does not create a named-pipe listener, set proxy launch environment, enable call_lua, or claim queue/timeouts that remain unrecovered.

reference.startupRegistrationCaller: RVA 0x3A231F adds 0x15F90 (90000 ms) to current clock before registration

registryContract.duplicatePolicy: same instanceId rejected if already present in pending or connected state
registryContract.refreshPolicy: only an existing unclaimed pending registration may receive a positive new deadline
registryContract.firstHandshake: requires instanceId lookup, exact profileId, exact SHA-256 token hash, and deadline strictly greater than current time; then marks registration claimed
registryContract.reconnect: claimed registration is retained; profile/token checks remain, first-claim deadline check is skipped, and a newer connected route replaces the prior route
registryContract.generation: host-global UInt64 monotonic counter saturating at UInt64.MaxValue
registryContract.ordinaryDisconnect: removes connected route only when both instanceId and connection generation match; retained registration is not removed
registryContract.explicitUnregister: removes pending registration and connected route for the instance key
registryContract.defaultRoute: literal default resolves only when exactly one connected route exists
registryContract.staleProtection: old connection generation cannot remove a newer reconnect route

harnessCorrection.finding: R7-097 status/RPC calls had been inserted inside the focused --overview-close-timing-check branch instead of the main default sequence.
harnessCorrection.impact: R7-097 focused RPC protocol check itself passed and the ordinary deterministic suite passed, but the RPC guard was not actually invoked by every default run as previously intended.
harnessCorrection.correction: R7-098 removes those calls from the close-timing branch and places status, RPC protocol and registry checks in the main deterministic sequence.

remainingBlocker: Recover exact transport listener/I/O queue limits and timeouts plus the authentic proxy launch environment binding before constructing a live host or enabling allowlisted call_lua(getStatus).
